questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:08 to 00:12, the board is fully visible and holds exactly three pens in a row.
All three pens are oriented vertically with the black cap at the bottom and the clear barrel at the top, parallel to each other.
All three pens appear identical with black caps and clear/translucent barrels.
All pens are capped (black end down) and appear to be of equal length.

The board moves from left to center (00:00-00:08), then stops and remains stationary for approximately 4 seconds (00:08-00:12) before resuming movement to the right. This constitutes a pause/motion failure.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board throughout the clip.

parsed.reason: The board pauses in the center of the frame for several seconds (approx. 00:08 to 00:12) instead of moving smoothly and continuously from left to right.

description: Three identical pens moving left to right on the board, smooth continuous motion.
